name: agile-team-orchestrator
description: Lifecycle coordinator for the Agile Team (Agent Agile Force). Drives the product-delivery lifecycle (idea -> production); Phase 2 runs the clarifying stage (PCA intake normalization). Makes no LLM calls itself - it sequences agent stages, enforces human gates, validates artifacts, and threads the handoff downstream. run.py is the CLI entry; worker.py is the queue-driven execution arm for the in-app trigger.

entry_points.worker: agents/teams/agile/worker.py (polls public.agile_intake_jobs; the in-app trigger's executor)

drives: reformai.product-clarification-agent (clarifying stage; via pca.run_intake with parent_run_id)

writes.telemetry: run_started / run_completed / run_failed to /api/ingest under this agent_id (one orchestrator run per job; PCA child links via parent_run_id)
